about: Windows 11 hidden-icons flyout: icons only in a small grid, no header while no item is open. Matched against plasma-workspace 6.3.6 (Debian 13).

replacements.why: no text labels next to hidden icons
replacements.new: visible: false // VeltOS: icons only, like Windows 11
readonly property int delegateHeight: Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.smallMedium + Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing * 2 // VeltOS

replacements.why: small flyout while no item is open
replacements.new:
// VeltOS: as small as the icons need while no item is open.
    readonly property int veltosIconsWidth: hiddenItemsView.layout.cellHeight * 4 + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing * 2
    readonly property int veltosIconsHeight: hiddenItemsView.layout.cellHeight * Math.max(1, Math.ceil(hiddenItemsView.layout.itemCount / 4)) + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing * 2
    Layout.minimumWidth: systemTrayState.activeApplet ? Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 24 : veltosIconsWidth
    Layout.minimumHeight: systemTrayState.activeApplet ? Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 24 : veltosIconsHeight
    Layout.preferredWidth: Layout.minimumWidth
    Layout.preferredHeight: Layout.minimumHeight
    Layout.maximumWidth: systemTrayState.activeApplet ? Infinity : veltosIconsWidth
    Layout.maximumHeight: systemTrayState.activeApplet ? Infinity : veltosIconsHeight
